source.title: Home | Golden Lotus 金莲 Restaurant
source.raw_text:
Golden Lotus 金莲 Restaurant
Welcome to Golden Lotus 金莲, a family restaurant serving Cantonese dishes in the heart of Ipoh since 1998.
Our dim sum is made fresh every morning, and our roast duck has been the same recipe for three generations.
Opening Hours
Open daily from 7am to 3pm and from 5pm to 10pm. Closed on the first day of Chinese New Year.
Reservations
Call us to book a table for groups of eight or more. 欢迎光临!

discovered_pages.raw_text:
Our Menu
Steamed har gow, siu mai, char siu bao and egg tarts are served until 3pm.
In the evening we serve roast duck, steamed fish, claypot rice and seasonal vegetables.
